rationale: The agent verified the user via email, retrieved the correct recent order, and identified eligible return items accurately. However, it submitted the return request without first obtaining the user's explicit confirmation of the exact change, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing action. The rest of the information provided (refund to Visa ending 8991, return instructions via email) was consistent with tool data. Due to the lack of pre-action confirmation, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
